About RainFocus

 

RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun, and exciting.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior GRC Analyst to join our Security and Privacy team. In this role, you will own and grow RainFocus's governance, risk, and compliance program â maintaining our control framework, leading risk assessments, supporting audits, and driving the program's maturity forward rather than simply maintaining the status quo. You will report directly to the CISO and have significant ownership from day one.

\n


Key Responsibilities:
Lead RainFocus's GRC program across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and other client/regulatory compliance frameworks, including audit prep, evidence collection, and auditor relationships.
 
Manage and mature our control framework, mapping new regulations and conducting gap assessments.
 
Own the annual security risk assessment process (NIST SP 800-30 methodology), including stakeholder interviews, risk scoring, and residual risk tracking.
 
Maintain and update security policies, standards, and documentation to ensure compliance with industry best practices.
 
Partner with Engineering and Security to mature vulnerability management and secrets-scanning practices, moving these from reactive to proactive, pre-deployment controls.
 
Help build out and operationalize a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program, including policy design and rollout across email, endpoint, and cloud storage.
 
Grow and mature RainFocus's security awareness training program.
 
Drive AI governance efforts â policy, tooling, and monitoring for approved vs. unapproved AI tool usage across the company.
 
Identify and help close Shadow IT / unmanaged SaaS visibility gaps in partnership with IT.
 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement risk management practices and ensure compliance across the organization.
 
Respond to security and privacy inquiries from clients, partners, and employees.
 
Prepare and present reports on the organization's security and privacy compliance status, including program maturity and remediation progress.
Stay abreast of emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and compliance requirements.


Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field is highly desirable.

6+ years of proven experience in GRC, IT audit, information security compliance, or a related field.

In-depth knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST 800-series, GDPR, and others).

Experience running or contributing heavily to formal risk assessments â not just tracking a compliance checklist.

Professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CIPP, or CIPM are highly desirable.

Familiarity with modern security tooling such as Drata, OneTrust, Vanta, etc.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks is a plus.

Experience with OneTrust or related GRC technologies is a plus.


Personal Characteristics:

Strong work ethic and commitment to excellence.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Ability to adapt to change and learn quickly.

Passion for security and privacy.


\n

Why work at RainFocus?

 

At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

 

As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. 

 

What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

title: Influencer Marketing Lead
description:
At Aftershoot, we're building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.

From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.

We're a fast-growing, passionate team backed by 100K+ active users globally. Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and a team who truly believe in our mission.

Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world. If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we'd love to meet you.

Let's create the future of AI in photography, together.

About the Role

This is a function-owner role, not an execution role.

Aftershoot already invests seven figures a year into creators, and creator-led content is one of the biggest drivers of how photographers discover us. What we don't yet have is someone who owns it end to end: who decides where the money goes, which creators earn a renewal, what the content should actually say, and how we prove any of it worked.

That's you. You'll set the strategy, own the budget, build the partner roster, and lead a small team of executives who handle day-to-day outreach and campaign management. Most of our creators are based in the US, so you'll be working across US time zones on a regular basis.

You'll come in with a clear mandate: make the same spend go three times further, or deliver the same results for meaningfully less. Both are good answers.

What You'll Do

â¢ Own Aftershoot's global influencer and creator marketing strategy end to end, with the US as the primary market.

â¢ Own the annual creator budget: allocate it, defend it, sunset what isn't working, and double down on what is.

â¢ Build and maintain the partner roster across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, spanning photography, creative-tools, and tech audiences.â¢ Move the program from one-off sponsored posts toward recurring partnerships, ambassador structures, and long-term creator relationships.

â¢ Build the measurement layer: attribution, incrementality, cost per trial and per paid conversion by creator, so renewal decisions are made on evidence rather than instinct.

â¢ Negotiate rates, deliverables, exclusivity, and usage rights, including whitelisting so strong creator content can be repurposed into paid media.

â¢ Get content actually shipped: briefing creators, holding them to timelines, and getting the work over the line when it slips.

â¢ Hire, manage, and coach a team of 2â3 Influencer Marketing Executives.

â¢ Work closely with Growth, Content, Product Marketing, and Design so creator content plugs into the wider marketing engine rather than running beside it.

â¢ Plan and run creator activity around peak moments like Black Friday and major product launches.

â¢ Explore adjacent channels where they make sense: affiliate, community, events, and podcast partnerships.

What You'll Bring

â¢ 5â8 years in influencer, creator, or partnerships marketing, at an agency or in-house, with at least 2 of those years setting strategy rather than only executing campaigns.

â¢ Direct experience managing a meaningful creator budget, and the ability to walk us through how you spent it and what you got back.

â¢ Experience working with US or international creators, and comfort operating across time zones.

â¢ Excellent spoken and written English. Much of this job is video calls and negotiation with US-based creators, so you need to be clear, natural, and persuasive live.

â¢ Real negotiation instincts. Paying a creator is the beginning of the relationship, not the end of it, and getting good work out of a partner takes persistence and charm in equal measure.

â¢ Comfort with numbers: you can look at a campaign and form a point of view on whether it earned its keep.

â¢ Working knowledge of creator tooling and affiliate platforms (GRIN, CreatorIQ, Modash, Upfluence, Aspire, Impact.com, PartnerStack, or similar).

â¢ A bias toward action. We move fast, we test in the market rather than in slide decks, and we'd rather fix a live campaign than perfect a plan.

Nice to have, genuinely not required

â¢ A background in photography, creative tools, or prosumer software.

â¢ Experience in a consumer AI or global SaaS company.

â¢ Experience building a creator program from zero.

We are not filtering for photography experience. If you've built creator programs in D2C, gaming, fintech, or anywhere else that scales, the playbook travels.

What You'll Gain

â¢ Full ownership of a function from day one, with a seven-figure budget and no legacy playbook to inherit.

â¢ Direct line to leadership and real influence over how Aftershoot grows.

â¢ A global creator community in a category people are genuinely passionate about.

â¢ The chance to build a team around you as the program scales.

What Happens After You Apply?

  1. Phone Screen â If your profile looks like a fit, our People team will reach out for an intro call.

  2. Team Interview â A deeper conversation on your experience and how you've run creator programs before.

  3. Case Discussion â We'll share real context on our program a day ahead, then talk through how you'd approach it. No 20-slide deck required.

  4. Bar-Raiser Interview â Meet our leadership team for a final evaluation.

  5. Offer! â If it goes well, we'll extend a formal offer and welcome you on board.

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

title: Why do you want this new job
description:
No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â

In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far:

  • Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years.
  • Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance.
  • Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss.
  • Iâm looking for more challenging work.

All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills

Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills.

About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer.

If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job.

About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job.

Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it.

In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. As long as you are able to justify why you want the new job, theyâll be quite accommodating.

title: Head of Security
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

title: Clinical Coordination Manager
description:
Department: Support Operations

Reports To: Director, Support Operations

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Position Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Position Summary

The Clinical Coordinator Department Manager oversees the Clinical Coordination team responsible for maintaining accurate, appropriately filled provider schedules across all markets. This role provides leadership, operational oversight, training, workload management, process improvement, and cross-department collaboration to support consistent scheduling performance.

This leader sets daily and weekly priorities, delegates work, holds the team accountable, monitors current and upcoming schedule health, and identifies risks before they impact provider days. The manager ensures accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked and that scheduling barriers are tracked and escalated to the appropriate owner.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop Clinical Coordinators through clear priorities, delegation, accountability, and follow-through
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching, and ongoing training refreshers
  • Oversee team scheduling, workload balancing, and coverage across markets based on provider days, appointment volume, and overall workload
  • Support onboarding and competency development for new team members
  • Foster a positive, efficient, and collaborative culture grounded in service excellence and ownership

Appointment Readiness & Schedule Reliability

  • Monitor the 0-14-day schedule and upcoming weeks to identify open capacity, underfilled provider days, and scheduling risks early
  • Ensure accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked in accordance with provider availability, market zoning, and scheduling priorities
  • Ensure Clinical Coordinators identify, track, and escalate scheduling barriers, including outstanding medical clearances, insurance verification, pre-medication needs, facility documentation, and lab-case concerns, to the appropriate department or owner
  • Monitor Clinical Days at Goal and schedule disruptions to ensure timely follow-up and improve filled provider days across applicable markets
  • Ensure schedules are entered timely and accurately while production-based scheduling remains focused appropriately

Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze recurring scheduling barriers, backlog trends, fall-aparts, and schedule-health concerns to identify operational gaps and root causes
  • Develop preventive strategies and implement workflow or SOP improvements within Clinical Coordination
  • Coordinate any workflow change affecting another department or external partner with the appropriate department leader or Account Manager before implementation
  • Support system optimization, automation initiatives, and process refinements in CareStack and Healier

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner across departments to resolve scheduling barriers, maintain clear ownership, and support consistent patient flow
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex scheduling needs or facility and provider concerns
  • Independently address department concerns, communicate risks and updates, and escalate to the Director when additional leadership support is needed

Data, Reporting & Accountability

  • Monitor and report team performance and operational health indicators, including:
  • Clinical Days at Goal
  • 0-14-day schedule health and upcoming provider weeks
  • Accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlog progress
  • Schedule-entry timeliness
  • Reschedule, cancellation, and fall-apart trends
  • Outstanding scheduling barriers and escalations
  • Provide weekly insights, actions taken, next steps, and performance updates to leadership
  • Ensure accurate documentation standards in CareStack and Healier

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years in dental, medical, or clinical scheduling/coordination; minimum 2 years leadership experience
  • Systems: Experience with CareStack, or similar EMR platforms and Google Suite required
  • Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical/dental workflows, provider scheduling, multi-facility coordination, pre-med & medical clearance processes, insurance verification, lab case coordination, and multi-facility scheduling
  • Leadership: Demonstrated success managing remote teams, assigning and delegating work, coaching performance, holding employees accountable, and implementing process improvements.
  • Skills:
    • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
    • Strong organizational, delegation, and prioritization abilities
    • Ability to independently assess problems, make decisions, and follow through
    • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment
Key Competencies

  • Leadership & team development
  • Delegation, accountability & follow-through
  • Proactive problem solving & root-cause thinking
  • Schedule-health oversight & workload management
  • Workflow optimization & accuracy
  • Efficient decision-making & prioritization
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Service-minded communication with professionalism and empathy

Work Environment

  • Fully remote role requiring reliable internet access
  • Requires ongoing communication with team members, facilities, providers, and internal departments via virtual platforms
  • Occasional travel for leadership meetings, in-field shadow sessions, or training as needed

Benefits

Compensation: Base compensation $60,000-65,000 annually

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Life Insurance, Paid Time Off

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Warehouse Trainer (m/w/d)
description:
At Knuspr, speed matters. Quality matters. But none of it works without people who know what they’re doing from day one.

That’s where our trainers come in.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Trainer who will help new colleagues settle in fast, learn the job properly, and grow into confident, high-performing team members. This role is part onboarding, part coaching, part culture-building — and a big part of what makes our warehouse teams work well together.

If you enjoy working with people, teaching by example, and helping others improve every day, this could be a great fit.

 

Why this role is exciting

  • You’ll have a direct impact on how quickly new employees become productive and confident.

  • You’ll help shape team culture on the warehouse floor — not from behind a desk.

  • You’ll work closely with managers and become a key partner in performance, onboarding and development.

  • You’ll support both newcomers and existing employees, so no two days look the same.

  • You’ll be in a role where people genuinely rely on you — for guidance, clarity and support

What you’ll do

You’ll be responsible for helping warehouse employees learn, improve and succeed in daily operations.

You will:

  • Coordinate onboarding for new warehouse employees

  • Train employees across different warehouse departments and processes

  • Support the creation and improvement of training materials and methods

  • Give regular feedback, motivate people and help them improve performance

  • Identify where individuals need more support and create practical improvement plans

  • Check whether warehouse rules and processes are followed correctly

  • Work closely with managers on training progress and employee development

  • Help introduce new warehouse processes and make sure teams understand them

  • Evaluate training effectiveness and suggest improvements based on real needs

  • Be the go-to person for everyday questions, support and guidance on the floor

  • Act as a role model for Rohlik culture, teamwork and customer orientation

What we’re looking for

  • At least 1 year of training experience; warehouse or operations background

  • Open-minded, hands-on and comfortable in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong communicator with a natural feel for working with people

  • Calm under pressure and able to make quick, fair decisions

  • Structured, attentive and focused on helping others improve

  • Comfortable using apps, tools and new technologies

  • Self-starter who can work independently and get things done

  • Strong customer-oriented mindset, even in an operational role

Language requirements: You need professional working proficiency in English or German. Additional foreign languages are a strong advantage.

 

What we offer

  • Your work will have a direct impact on the company's results

  • We will implement your good ideas almost immediately – not waiting for the approval of the headquarters somewhere in the world

  • You will not be bound by corporate processes

  • Your work has to be innovative and meaningful, we do not want to follow trends, but set them

  • Last but not least, we offer a fair reward for your work and the possibility for professional growth and further education. We also offer you to be part of a great bunch of people and to attend a legendary corporate event.

title: Growth Marketing Manager - Performance Marketing (m/f/d)
description:
About Placetel

We are all connected by one goal: making communication simple. Placetel stands for modern, innovative, AI-native communication and CX solutions from the cloud. More than 40,000 business customers use Placetel every day to call and collaborate successfully – whether in the office, at home or on the go. Since our founding in 2008 we have grown continuously and are today part of Gamma Communications. Together we are changing the way people work around the world. Today and in the future.

Tasks

Your role

As Growth Marketing Manager – Performance Marketing you own paid acquisition at Placetel. You bring in the trials and the paying customers that our self-service growth model runs on – with real budget responsibility, across Google, Meta and every channel we have not tested yet.

One thing up front, because it shapes how we work: winning SMB customers in Germany looks far more like winning customers for a DTC brand than like classic enterprise B2B. High volume, short consideration cycles, creative-led, measured daily. That is how we run growth – and that is the mindset we are hiring for.

What you will do

  • Own our paid acquisition budget end to end – strategy, channel mix, allocation and daily optimisation – and be accountable for the outcome.
  • Plan, launch and scale campaigns across Google Ads (Search, PMax, YouTube) and Meta, plus additional channels such as LinkedIn, TikTok, Reddit, native, affiliate and comparison portals.
  • Manage to unit economics, not vanity metrics: trials, trial-to-paid, CAC, payback period and LTV/CAC are your scoreboard.
  • Build a systematic testing cadence – audiences, bidding, offers, landing pages, creative angles – with clear hypotheses, decision rules and documented learnings.
  • Work hand in hand with our Creative Strategist: you brief which angles to test, you read the results, you decide what scales and what dies.
  • Own tracking, attribution and measurement together with our analytics and eCommerce colleagues – GA4, GTM, server-side tracking, conversion values, offline conversion uploads from the CRM.
  • Optimise the full path from ad to trial to paid customer: landing pages, signup flow, offers and pricing tests – together with Growth, Product and Sales.
  • Open up channels we do not run yet and decide quickly whether they earn a permanent budget line.
  • Report performance transparently and in plain language: what worked, what did not, what we do next.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

  • Several years of hands-on performance marketing with genuine budget responsibility – ideally in B2B SaaS and/or in a DTC or high-velocity consumer brand. Both together is the strongest profile we can imagine for this role.
  • Pro in one channel, solid in the rest. You are the person others ask about Google Ads or Meta, and you can competently run the other channels yourself.
  • You think in unit economics: CAC, payback, LTV/CAC and contribution margin are part of your everyday vocabulary.
  • Confident with tracking, attribution and analytics setups – you fix broken measurement instead of waiting for someone else to.
  • A real creative instinct: you can judge an ad, brief a better one and spot a winning angle before the data fully confirms it.
  • Structured tester: hypothesis, sample size, decision rule, learning written down and shared.
  • Hands-on mentality and high ownership – you make budget calls without needing a committee.
  • Fluent German and English. Our customers are German SMBs; you need to feel the language they are being sold in.
  • A degree in marketing, business, business informatics or a comparable field – or an equivalent track record that speaks for itself.

Optional and nice to have

  • Experience with free-trial or freemium subscription models and self-service checkout.
  • Experience with comparison portals, affiliate and marketplace channels in Germany.
  • Experience running paid in more than one market or language.

Benefits

What we offer

  • Full ownership of a meaningful acquisition budget and direct, visible impact on growth and revenue.
  • A young, ambitious team of marketing, product and tech experts with a real growth mentality.
  • A company that is deliberately building a digital, self-service growth model – you will not be fighting the organisation to run modern growth.
  • Hybrid working model with flexible hours and a genuine remote culture – we care about output, not attendance.
  • Extensive learning and development opportunities across growth, SaaS and AI.
  • Central office location in Cologne’s Südstadt, modern workspaces and high-quality equipment. Water, coffee and fresh fruit included.
  • Open, collegial company culture with regular team events.

We are looking for a Berlin-based detail-oriented Working Student (all genders) to support our Content Operations team in maintaining and managing digital product content.

In this role, you will help ensure that digital assets and product data are accurately maintained across our systems, enabling smooth campaign launches and consistent product information across markets. You will work with digital experience platforms such as CMS (Content Management Systems) and other content tools, contributing to keeping product and marketing content structured, reliable, and scalable. 

Your work plays a key role in maintaining high data quality and supporting efficient content operations.


What you´ll do

In this role, you will support operational content processes and ensure high-quality product data across systems.

Operational execution

  • Support content maintenance activities across digital platforms such as CMS, PIM, DAM, based on defined briefs
  • Clean, archive, and reorganize assets according to guidelines provided
  • Link assets correctly within the PIM environment after DAM upload
  • Support additional operational content tasks such as migrations, content updates, testing, or data validation activities, bulk updates, and checking that content is published and displayed as per the briefs.


Quality & compliance

  • Follow documented processes and governance rules carefully
  • Maintain tracking documentation (e.g. Excel trackers for updates and changes)
  • Perform peer quality checks before delivering tasks
  • Identify and flag missing information or inconsistencies in briefs

Coordination & reporting

  • Provide updates on task progress
  • Escalate blockers early to help maintain timelines
  • Document recurring issues to support process improvements

 

What success looks like in this role

  • Deliver accurate uploads and content or product data updates
  • Maintain correct linking between DAM and PIM systems with zero critical errors
  • Complete tasks within agreed service-level timelines (SLA)
  • Handle larger batches of tasks reliably without loss of quality
  • Reduce rework through thorough quality checks
  • Proactively identify recurring data inconsistencies or improvement opportunities


What you can offer

  • Must be enrolled as a student in a German university for at least another year.
  • Strong attention to detail, process orientation, and ownership of accurate, high-quality data
  • Basic Excel and structured data skills, with the ability to understand relationships, dependencies, and troubleshoot issues
  • Proactive communication when questions, blockers, or inconsistencies occur
  • Good technical affinity with interest in digital systems, content tools, and AI-supported ways of working
  • Comfortable reading documentation and applying defined guidelines carefully
  • Ability to work independently after onboarding while knowing when to ask for support
  • Above all, curiosity and genuine interest in learning how we work

Nice to have

  • Experience with CMS Tridion, PIM, DAM, or similar systems
  • Experience working with custom digital interfaces or content tools


What we offer

  • Work-Life Wellbeing. At ctrl QS, we value your well-being and encourage our team members to maintain a healthy balance between work and personal. We understand that agency life can be highly dynamic and fast-paced, therefore we utilize a time-tracking tool to ensure you receive appropriate compensation through time off for any extra hours worked. Our company offers a flexible working environment, providing options for both full-time and part-time positions. Additionally, you'll enjoy 28 days of vacation every year, ensuring you have the time to recharge and explore your passions outside of work.
  • Vibrant Office in Central Berlin. Located in the digital heart of central Berlin, our bright office space fosters professional and personal interactions.
  • Continuous Learning and Career Growth. We're dedicated to providing a unique learning environment where you can pursue your career goals. We help you find your place at ctrl QS, with a focus on your development goals. You’ll find fluid career paths with opportunities to specialize or grow laterally. Also, our internal Academy offers a wealth of learning opportunities.
  • Diverse and Supportive Team. Join our team of 190 passionate, committed, and fun people from more than 40 nations. We celebrate diversity and welcome everyone to bring their unique perspectives, challenge conventions, and ignite creativity. Together, we form a multicultural and fun-loving team that thrives on collaboration.
  • People-First Culture. At ctrl QS, we prioritize our people above all else. We strive to cultivate a healthy company culture where everyone feels safe and satisfied. Engage in regular team-building activities, fun sport and health initiatives, monthly team lunches, weekly company breakfasts, and regular team events are all part of the routine. And of course, our famous summer and Christmas parties are not to be missed!

description:
About Placetel

What you will do

  • Own the creative engine for paid social – primarily Meta, with TikTok and YouTube as we expand.
  • Turn insight into angles: mine customer reviews, support tickets, sales calls, churn reasons, competitor ads and customer conversations for what German SMBs actually say about their phone system, their calls and their missed business.
  • Build and run a creative testing roadmap: a steady, predictable volume of new concepts every week, structured by angle, format and hook so results are readable rather than anecdotal.

  • Brief and direct creators, editors, actors and freelancers, run shoots, and manage the production pipeline end to end so throughput never becomes the bottleneck.
  • Analyse creative performance at the right level with the Performance Marketing Manager – hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA and trial rate per angle – and decide what to iterate, scale or kill.
  • Maintain a living library of winners, losers and learnings so we compound instead of restarting every quarter.

  • Experience building and managing a creator or UGC network.
  • Experience with AI-supported creative production (generative video, voice, image, automated variation).

title: Growth Marketing Manager - Automation (m/f/d)
description:
About Placetel

We are all connected by one goal: making communication simple. Placetel stands for modern, innovative, AI-native communication and CX solutions from the cloud. More than 40,000 business customers use Placetel every day to call and collaborate successfully – whether in the office, at home or on the go. Since our founding in 2008 we have grown continuously and are today part of Gamma Communications. Together we are changing the way people work around the world. Today and in the future.

Tasks

Your role

As Growth Marketing Manager – Automation you own the automated systems that carry a user from first signup through activation to expansion – and the CRM and AI infrastructure underneath them. Our growth model is self-service and low-touch by design. That only works if the machine behind it is genuinely good.

HubSpot sits at the centre of that machine, connected to product usage data, billing and our web and trial funnel. Your job is to make it do more, do it automatically, and do it with AI agents built natively into the flow – not bolted on as an afterthought.

We are deliberately open on the shape of this role. There are two ways to be excellent at it, and we will build the role around whichever one you bring.

What you will do – the core

  • Own our marketing and sales automation stack, with HubSpot (Marketing + Sales Hub) at the centre and clean connections to product, billing, website and trial funnel.
  • Design, build and continuously improve automated journeys across the whole lifecycle: trial onboarding, activation nudges, lead scoring and routing, upsell and cross-sell, win-back and churn prevention.
  • Replace manual processes with automation – every recurring task a human does today is a candidate, in marketing and in sales.
  • Build AI agents into the funnel natively: qualification, enrichment, routing, response drafting, content generation. Not just AI features inside HubSpot.
  • Keep our data trustworthy: lifecycle stages, attribution and product-usage signals flowing reliably between systems.
  • Measure what you build – every journey has a metric, a baseline and an iteration plan.
  • Work closely with Sales, Product, Growth Analytics and eCommerce, and make their work easier by removing manual steps from it.

Two possible focus areas – pick yours

You should be strong in one of these and comfortable in the other. Tell us in your application which one is yours.

Focus A – Technical / AI Automation

  • You architect HubSpot rather than just operate it: data model, custom objects and properties, APIs, webhooks, integrations.
  • You build automations beyond HubSpot too – with workflow tools (n8n, Make, Zapier) and with LLM and agent frameworks.
  • You are comfortable with APIs, JSON and enough Python or JavaScript to ship something yourself instead of queueing behind engineering.
  • You have already built working agentic automations, not just prototyped with a chat interface.

Focus B – Lifecycle & Content Automation

  • You own the content inside the journeys: onboarding series, activation emails, in-product messaging, nurture and reactivation tracks.
  • You write German copy that sounds like a person wrote it, not a workflow – and you use AI to produce more of it, faster, without losing that.
  • You design journeys around real user behaviour and know which message at which moment actually moves the metric.
  • You are relentless about testing subject lines, timing, triggers and sequencing.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

  • Several years in marketing and sales automation, lifecycle marketing, marketing ops or CRM – ideally in B2B SaaS with a self-service or product-led motion.
  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience: workflows, custom properties and objects, lists, lifecycle stages, reporting. You know where its limits are and how to work around them.

title: Mitarbeiter Buchungsmanagement & Gästeservice (m/w/d)
description:
Werde Teil unseres Operations-Teams

Nutze die Chance, Teil unseres wachsenden Teams bei der Homery Living GmbH in Vörstetten zu werden und deine Karriere im strukturierten Umfeld des Unterkunftsmanagements zu gestalten.

Wir suchen neue Mitarbeiter für unser Operations-Team, die uns dabei unterstützen, das Buchungs- und Unterkunftsmanagement unserer Standorte zu steuern, mit Firmenkunden und Gästen zu kommunizieren und einen reibungslosen Ablauf von der Buchungsanfrage bis zur Abreise sicherzustellen.

Wenn du kommunikativ und redegewandt bist, gerne mit Kunden und Gästen arbeitest und gleichzeitig Wert auf klare Prozesse und strukturierte Arbeitsabläufe legst, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Über Homery Living GmbH

Die Homery Living GmbH mit Sitz in Vörstetten ist spezialisiert auf das Management und die operative Verwaltung von Monteurunterkünften. Wir bieten umfangreiche Dienstleistungen im Bereich Buchungs- und Unterkunftsmanagement an und zeichnen uns durch klare Prozesse und Strukturen aus.

Unser Ansatz ist es, alle operativen Abläufe direkt vom Büro aus zu steuern. Dazu gehören die Gästekommunikation, die Zusammenarbeit mit Firmenkunden sowie die Organisation der Buchungen, Preisgestaltung, Rechnungsstellung, Kalenderverwaltung, Reinigungskoordination und Problemlösung.

Die Homery Living GmbH verwaltet derzeit über 1.000 Betten an verschiedenen Standorten in Deutschland und gewährleistet durch bewährte Methoden, dokumentierte Prozesse und klare Strukturen stabile und zuverlässige Dienstleistungen.

Unser Unternehmen steht für Qualität, professionelle Abwicklung und den Anspruch, sowohl für unsere Kunden als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter langfristig verlässliche Strukturen zu schaffen.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

Du steuerst gemeinsam mit unserem Operations-Team die täglichen Abläufe rund um unsere Monteurunterkünfte. Deine Arbeit findet dabei überwiegend digital und telefonisch von unserem Büro in Vörstetten aus statt.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

  • Bearbeitung und Koordination von Buchungsanfragen
  • Telefonische und schriftliche Kommunikation mit Firmenkunden und Gästen
  • Erstellung und Versand von Angeboten und Rechnungen
  • Preisverhandlungen mit Kunden
  • Verwaltung und Pflege unserer Buchungskalender
  • Koordination von Reinigungen und weiteren operativen Abläufen
  • Bearbeitung und Lösung auftretender Probleme während eines Aufenthalts
  • Abstimmung mit unserem internen Team sowie externen Dienstleistern
  • Sicherstellung eines strukturierten Ablaufs von der Buchungsanfrage bis zur Abreise

Qualifikation

Welcher berufliche Hintergrund zu uns passt

Besonders gut passt diese Position zu dir, wenn du bereits Erfahrung in der Hotellerie, im Reservierungsmanagement oder in der Gästebetreuung gesammelt hast.

Geeignete berufliche Hintergründe sind beispielsweise:

  • Hotelfachfrau / Hotelfachmann
  • Kaufmann / Kauffrau für Hotelmanagement
  • Reservierungsmitarbeiter / Reservierungsmitarbeiterin
  • Reservation Agent
  • Front Office Agent
  • Front Office Manager
  • Rezeptionist / Rezeptionistin
  • Empfangsmitarbeiter / Empfangsmitarbeiterin im Hotel
  • Guest Service Agent
  • Mitarbeiter / Mitarbeiterin im Reservierungs- oder Buchungsmanagement

Dabei handelt es sich bei uns nicht um eine klassische Tätigkeit an einer Hotelrezeption. Die operative Betreuung unserer Unterkünfte wird zentral aus unserem Büro gesteuert. Der Kontakt zu Kunden und Gästen erfolgt hauptsächlich telefonisch sowie per E-Mail und WhatsApp.

Auch Quereinsteiger mit einem passenden beruflichen Hintergrund und den entsprechenden persönlichen Voraussetzungen können sich bei uns bewerben.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Du bist kommunikativ, überzeugungsstark und redegewandt.
  • Du hast Freude am professionellen Umgang mit Gästen und Firmenkunden.
  • Du kannst bestehenden Prozessen zuverlässig folgen und arbeitest gerne innerhalb klar definierter Abläufe.
  • Du besitzt eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe.
  • Du arbeitest diszipliniert, zuverlässig und sorgfältig.
  • Du verfügst über starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten.
  • Du verfügst über eine saubere und fehlerfreie schriftliche Ausdrucksform in deutscher Sprache.
  • Du kannst auch bei mehreren gleichzeitig anfallenden Aufgaben strukturiert arbeiten und den Überblick behalten.

Benefits

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsumgebung: Eine durchorganisierte Arbeitsweise für eine effektive und zielorientierte Tätigkeit.
  • Dokumentierte Arbeitsprozesse: Klar nachvollziehbare Abläufe für effiziente und fehlerfreie Arbeitsschritte.
  • Sicherer und langfristiger Arbeitsplatz: Wir möchten gemeinsam mit unseren Mitarbeitern langfristig wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine dauerhafte und unbefristete Zusammenarbeit.
  • Leistungsbasierte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Bei entsprechender Leistung und persönlicher Entwicklung bestehen klare Möglichkeiten, innerhalb des Unternehmens zusätzliche Verantwortung zu übernehmen und sich beruflich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung: Regelmäßige Möglichkeiten zur Erweiterung deiner fachlichen Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten.
  • Positives und kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld: Uns ist wichtig, dass wir gerne miteinander arbeiten, uns gegenseitig unterstützen und gemeinsam an unseren Zielen arbeiten. Wir ziehen an einem Strang, motivieren uns gegenseitig zu guten Leistungen und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung möglich ist.
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Für die Position ist ein Bruttogehalt von 3.500 € monatlich vorgesehen.

Unser Büro am Standort Vörstetten

Am Standort Vörstetten erwartet dich auf einer Bürofläche von 140 Quadratmetern ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld. Ausgestattet mit elektrisch höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen und modernen Arbeitsgeräten, unterstützt unser Büro optimal deine Arbeitsabläufe.

Das Bürogebäude bietet durch Klimaanlage, Fußbodenheizung und Raumbelüftung eine angenehme und ruhige Arbeitsatmosphäre. Stellplätze direkt vor unserem Bürogebäude machen das Parken einfach und bequem.

Das neu entwickelte Industriegebiet, in dem sich unser Standort befindet, zeichnet sich durch seine ruhige Lage und eine gute Busanbindung aus, die dir eine unkomplizierte Anreise ermöglicht.

Deine Einarbeitung & unsere digitale Schulungsplattform

Für deine Einarbeitung planen wir je nach Vorerfahrung etwa 4 bis 8 Wochen ein.

Du erhältst direkt zum Start Zugriff auf unsere digitale Schulungsplattform, die dir alle notwendigen Inhalte für deine neue Tätigkeit bereitstellt. Die Einarbeitung wird durch die Leitung Operations koordiniert, damit du von Anfang an gezielt in alle relevanten Abläufe eingeführt wirst.

Der erste Teil der Einarbeitung wird persönlich durchgeführt. Ergänzend stehen dir Schulungsvideos, schriftliche Anleitungen und dokumentierte Prozesse zur Verfügung, die deine Aufgaben Schritt für Schritt erklären.

Dadurch weißt du nicht nur, was zu tun ist, sondern kannst bei Fragen jederzeit auf bestehende Abläufe und Anleitungen zurückgreifen. Auch Quereinsteiger können dadurch systematisch in ihre neue Tätigkeit eingearbeitet werden.

Die wichtigsten Eckdaten

Position: Mitarbeiter Operations / Buchungs- & Unterkunftsmanagement (m/w/d)
Arbeitsort: Vörstetten
Beschäftigungsart: Vollzeit
Vergütung: 3.500 € brutto pro Monat
Einarbeitungszeit: ca. 4–8 Wochen
Perspektive: Langfristige Zusammenarbeit mit dem Ziel einer unbefristeten Beschäftigung

description:
It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents.

All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

Tasks

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Azure Cloud Security Consultant (m/w/d) located in Germany to join our Cloud Security team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Azure cloud services, with a particular focus on security, logging, and monitoring solutions. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining robust security and monitoring architectures within a multi-tenant Azure environment.

  • Design and implement Azure Lighthouse to effectively manage Microsoft Sentinel workspaces across a multi-tenant environment.
  • Oversee the implementation and maintenance of the security logging and monitoring platform in Azure, including designing the architecture, to provide comprehensive security insights and data protection.

  • Conduct cloud security monitoring by defining relevant use cases to detect and respond to security threats efficiently.
  • Collaborate with various stakeholders to ensure the successful implementation and deployment of resources, configurations, and security measures.
  • Document high-level (HL) and low-level (LL) designs, as-built architecture, processes, and create detailed implementation documents to maintain accurate records and facilitate knowledge transfer.

title: Praktikant:in Business Development (m/w/d)
description:
Über die Rolle

Die audibene Teleaudiologie ist der am schnellsten wachsende Geschäftsbereich bei audibene. Wir betreuen unsere Kunden von der ersten Beratung bis zur finalen Anpassung vollständig digital im Wohnzimmer der Kunden und bauen dieses Modell gerade in hohem Tempo weiter aus.

Genau hier steigst du ein: Du arbeitest mit uns daran, Kunden in der Hörgeräte-Testphase Mehrwert zu bieten und damit unsere Fitting-to-Sale-Rate zu steigern. Du bekommst eigene Projekte, arbeitest direkt mit dem Management-Team zusammen und siehst innerhalb weniger Wochen, was deine Arbeit bewirkt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Analysen: Du führst eigenständig quantitative Analysen zu zentralen Kennzahlen durch – etwa zu Rabatten und Pricing, Abbruchraten im Verkaufsprozess, dem durchschnittlichen Warenkorbwert (ABV) oder der Sales-Performance nach Tageszeit und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für das Management ab.
  • Hörtagebuch: Du entwickelst unser Hörtagebuch weiter, das monatlich an über 1.000 Kund:innen verschickt wird. Du begleitest die Optimierung, sammelst Feedback ein und verbesserst das Erlebnis Schritt für Schritt.
  • After Sales Angebote: Du konzipierst operative Workflows für neue Serviceangebote und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Tagesgeschäft wirklich ankommen.
  • Nah am Kunden: Du unterstützt punktuell im telefonischen Kundenkontakt, z. B. beim technischen Setup der Hörerlebnisbox oder bei der Qualifizierung von Studienteilnehmer:innen. So bekommst du ein direktes Gefühl dafür, worüber deine Zahlen eigentlich sprechen.

Wie wir arbeiten

  • Customer First: Jede Entscheidung startet bei der Frage, was sie für unsere Kund:innen besser macht, nicht bei der internen Bequemlichkeit.
  • Ideen testen statt endlos diskutieren: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, und wir probieren sie gemeinsam aus. Bei uns zählt der schnelle Test in der Praxis mehr als das perfekte Konzept auf Folie.
  • Zahlen statt Bauchgefühl: Empfehlungen belegst du mit Daten. Eine gute Intuition ist der Startpunkt, nicht die Begründung.
  • Kollaboration ist der Hebel: Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Business Ops, Tech, Logistik, Akustiker:innen und Customer Service zusammen. Gute Lösungen entstehen bei uns nur ganzheitlich.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast Lust, dich eigenständig in fachfremde Themen einzuarbeiten von Datenanalyse über Prozessdesign bis Kundenkommunikation.
  • Du bist analytisch und argumentierst mit Zahlen statt aus dem Bauch heraus. Sicherer Umgang mit Excel/Google Sheets (Pivot, Lookups, saubere Datenstrukturen) ist Voraussetzung; ein Gefühl für die betriebswirtschaftliche Interpretation der Daten z. B. Conversion Rates ist ein klares Plus.
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag. Erste Berührungspunkte mit HTML oder CMS-Tools sind ein Plus vor allem zählt, dass du Lust hast, dir Neues beizubringen.
  • Du arbeitest autonom und treibst deine Projekte selbst voran und bist gleichzeitig bereit, von uns stark gefordert und gecoacht zu werden. Wenig Handhalten, viel Verantwortung.
  • Du bist frustrationstolerant: Wenn der erste Weg nicht funktioniert, suchst du den zweiten.
  • Du bist ein Allrounder-Typ: analytisch und technikaffin, aber genauso sicher in der Kommunikation mit Kund:innen und Kolleg:innen.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und bist fließend in Englisch.
  • Du studierst aktuell (Wirtschaft, Gesundheitsmanagement, o. Ä.) oder hast dein Studium kürzlich abgeschlossen und bringst bereits erste Praktikumserfahrung mit.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Einfluss: Präge das Wachstum von audibene vom ersten Tag an
  • Wachstum: Lerne von unseren Expertinnen und Experten und entwickle Deine Fähigkeiten in unserem GROWTH-Programm, um Deine Karriere aufs nächste Level zu bringen
  • Vertrauen: Erlebe ein hohes Maß an Autonomie und Verantwortung für bereichernde Projekte
  • Dynamisches Umfeld: Wir fördern und unterstützen neue Initiativen, schnelle Entscheidungsfindung und das Eingehen von Risiken
  • Internationales Team: Arbeite mit aufgeschlossenen und internationalen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven einbringen
  • Events: Nimm an unseren regelmäßigen Team-Events, Partys und jährlichen Offsites teil
  • Flexibilität: Genieße eine hybride Arbeitskultur und unser schönes Berliner Office
  • Damit du immer gut an dein Ziel kommst übernehmen wir für alle Mitarbeiter:innen das Deutschland-Ticket

Über audibene:

audibene/hear.com ist das am schnellsten wachsende Hörgeräte-Unternehmen aller Zeiten. Mit unserem einzigartigen digitalen Geschäftsmodell haben wir die Art und Weise der Hörgeräte-Versorgung revolutioniert. Unser Ursprung und Hauptsitz liegen in Deutschland. In den letzten 12 Jahren haben wir uns zu einem international tätigen Unternehmen mit mehr als 1.200 Mitarbeiter:innen entwickelt: an 9 Standorten weltweit von Berlin bis Seoul.

Werde Teil unserer Mission, die Industrie der Hörvorsorge neuzudenken und so Leben zu verändern! Bewirb dich jetzt!

Remmert ist spezialisiert auf automatisierte Lager- und Logistiksysteme. Wir wissen, wie man Bleche, Langgüter und Werkstücke platzsparend lagert und vollautomatisch bewegt. Maschinenbau/ Automation/Logistik - eine Branche mit Zukunftsperspektive!

Seit 1945 sind wir ein familiengeführtes Unternehmen und das leben wir - Entwicklungsperspektiven, Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe und kurze Entscheidungswege.

Wir wachsen kontinuierlich und suchen Kollegen/innen, die unser Team tatkräftig unterstützen.

Als Servicetechniker (gn) im Außendienst bist du selbstständig in deiner Region und weltweit unterwegs.

Aufgaben

  • Mechanischer Aufbau unserer Anlagen bei nationalen und internationalen Kunden vor Ort - 100% Reisebereitschaft mit einer durchschnittlichen Einsätzen von zwei bis drei Wochen
  • Selbstständige Durchführung von Inbetriebnahmen
  • Unterstützung beim Stellen von Stahlbauten und Einbringen von Komponenten
  • Durchführung von Service- und Wartungseinsätzen für unsere weltweiten
    Bestandskunden
  • Deine Arbeit ist abwechslungsreich, da wir zu einem Großteil individuelle Kundenanforderungen erfüllen

Qualifikation

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung (z.B. Mechatronik, Elektronik)
  • Berufseinsteiger oder mit Berufserfahrung im entsprechenden Bereich
  • Kommunikationsstark in Deutsch und Englisch
  • Französischkenntnisse sind wünschenswert
  • Selbständige Arbeitsweise, Teamplayer und Reisebereitschaft
  • Einen Führerschein der Klasse B

Benefits

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit 30 Tagen Urlaub
  • Mobiles Arbeiten (Hybrid) und flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Betriebliche Zusatzversicherung „Remmert Gesundheitskonto 600“ für jeden Mitarbeiter (gn): Jährliches persönliches Gesundheitsbudget in Höhe von 600 EUR Nettowert für z. B. ärztliche Vorsorgeuntersuchungen, Arznei-, Heil- und Hilfsmittel wie Hörgeräte und Sehhilfen (inkl. Sehschärfenkorrekturen), medizinische Massagen und Maßnahmen, Zahnersatz und Zahnprophylaxe, Naturheilverfahren u. v. m.
  • Bezuschussung von Zahnersatz von bis zu 70 Prozent
  • Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement (u. A. Gesundheitschecks, Vorsorgemaßnahmen während der Arbeitszeit, Laufgruppen, Teilnahme an Firmenläufen)
  • Sonderboni wie Gewinnbeteiligung, Mitarbeiter-werben-Mitarbeiter, E-Bike Leasing
  • Kaffee, Obst und Gemüse zum freien Verzehr – auch während der Arbeitszeiten
  • Entwicklungsperspektiven in Form von jährlichen Gehalts- und Jahresgesprächen (360 Grad)
  • Förderung von Weiterbildungen mit vorhandenem Weiterbildungskatalog für alle Berufsgruppen
  • Regelmäßige Mitarbeiterevents (Sommerausflug, Wandertage sowie Weihnachtsfeiern für alle Kollegen und deren Familien)
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge durch ein Zuschussmodell mit attraktiven Arbeitgeberbeiträgen

Du bist eine langfristig orientierte Persönlichkeit und kannst Dir vorstellen zum Team Remmert zu gehören?
